notes: Law nº 011/2025 of 27/05/2025 (Official Gazette n° Special of 29/05/2025) repealed and replaced the previous excise duty law (Law nº 050/2023). Its Annex lists approximately 27 excisable product/service categories with HS codes (juices, sodas, flavoured syrups, beer, wine, spirits, cigarettes, e-cigarettes, fuels, lubricants, motor vehicles by engine size, cosmetics, telecom airtime, money transfer fees, etc.). Only 7 representative items were transcribed and verified this cycle — NOT exhaustive.
